name: rosetta-range-expansion
code:
use default

expand(part: string) -> Pipe[int] is
    let split_at = (1..part.length)
        |> find(i => part[i] == '-' /\ char.is_digit(part[i - 1]))

    if let at = split_at then
        yield in int.parse(part[0..at])::int.parse(part[at + 1..<0])
    else
        yield int.parse(part)
    fi
si

let description = "-6,-3--1,3-5,7-11,14,15,17-20"

write_line(description.split([','])
    |> flat_map(expand)
    |> join(", "))
